AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a method of cleaning the home? (1 mark)
   A. Mopping
   B. Planting
   C. Sowing
   D. Grafting

2. Why should food be covered in the kitchen? (1 mark)
   A. To hide the plate
   B. To keep it hot forever
   C. To keep off flies, rats and cockroaches
   D. To make it heavier

3. Why should dusters and mops be washed after use? (1 mark)
   A. So they do not spread dirt and germs
   B. To make them smell
   C. To make them heavy
   D. So they wear out

4. Why is a damp cloth used for dusting? (1 mark)
   A. It dries the room
   B. It scatters the dust
   C. It traps the dust
   D. It hides dust

5. Which method wipes dust from furniture? (1 mark)
   A. Dusting
   B. Burning
   C. Sweeping
   D. Mopping

6. What is domestic hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping the home and its surroundings clean
   B. Growing food
   C. Cooking meals
   D. Washing your own body

7. In which direction do you sweep a room? (1 mark)
   A. Randomly
   B. From the corners towards the middle or door
   C. Only along the walls
   D. Only the middle

8. Which is the correct order for washing dishes? (1 mark)
   A. Any order in dirty water
   B. Rinse only with soap
   C. Least greasy first, greasy last
   D. Greasy first

9. Why do we sweep before mopping? (1 mark)
   A. To use more soap
   B. Because mops cannot touch water
   C. To waste time
   D. To remove loose dirt so it does not turn to mud

10. Why is a display of clean PPE useful? (1 mark)
   A. It helps others learn about PPE and hygiene
   B. It hides the PPE
   C. It wastes time
   D. It makes PPE dirty

11. What should you do with laces when cleaning canvas shoes? (1 mark)
   A. Burn them
   B. Remove and wash them separately
   C. Cut them
   D. Leave them dirty

12. How should gumboots be dried? (1 mark)
   A. Upside down in a shady, airy place
   B. Beside a hot fire
   C. Under a heavy weight
   D. In a closed cupboard while wet

13. Which PPE protects the feet from mud and water? (1 mark)
   A. Gumboots
   B. Gloves
   C. Dust mask
   D. Headgear

14. What is personal protective equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Clothing and gear worn to protect the body
   B. Food for health
   C. Soap for cleaning
   D. Tools for digging

15. Which PPE is thrown away rather than washed? (1 mark)
   A. Canvas shoes
   B. A cloth mask
   C. An overall
   D. A paper dust mask

16. How much of each edge is folded twice for the handkerchief hem? (1 mark)
   A. 20 cm
   B. 10 cm
   C. About 1 cm each time
   D. 1 mm

17. Which cloth is easiest for beginners? (1 mark)
   A. Wire mesh
   B. Cotton
   C. Thick leather
   D. Slippery silk

18. What size square did we cut for the handkerchief? (1 mark)
   A. 2 cm by 2 cm
   B. 5 m by 5 m
   C. 25 cm by 25 cm
   D. 1 m by 1 m

19. How should you carry scissors? (1 mark)
   A. With the points up
   B. With the points held down
   C. By the blades
   D. Running

20. What should you do with tacking when permanent sewing is done? (1 mark)
   A. Cut and pull it out
   B. Wash it
   C. Dye it
   D. Leave it for ever

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three reasons why a clean home is important. (3 marks)

22. State three safety rules when using needles and scissors. (3 marks)

23. Explain three mistakes to avoid when tacking. (3 marks)

24. How should cloth items such as overalls and cloth masks be cleaned? (3 marks)

25. Choose PPE for gardening and say why. (3 marks)

26. Why do we dust before sweeping? (2 marks)

27. Explain the meaning of domestic hygiene. (2 marks)

28. Give three uses of tacking stitches. (3 marks)

29. Name three methods of cleaning the home environment. (3 marks)

30. Give three ways of disposing of refuse safely. (3 marks)

31. Why is tacking better than pins alone? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #12 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Mopping
   Mopping cleans floors.

2. C — To keep off flies, rats and cockroaches
   Covered food is protected.

3. A — So they do not spread dirt and germs
   Dirty tools spread dirt.

4. C — It traps the dust
   Damp cloths hold dust.

5. A — Dusting
   Dusting removes dust from surfaces.

6. A — Keeping the home and its surroundings clean
   It is care of the home environment.

7. B — From the corners towards the middle or door
   This gathers dirt in one place.

8. C — Least greasy first, greasy last
   Water stays cleaner longer.

9. D — To remove loose dirt so it does not turn to mud
   Mopping dirt makes mud.

10. A — It helps others learn about PPE and hygiene
   Displays teach and encourage others.

11. B — Remove and wash them separately
   Laces need to be washed too.

12. A — Upside down in a shady, airy place
   This drains water and protects the rubber.

13. A — Gumboots
   Gumboots are waterproof.

14. A — Clothing and gear worn to protect the body
   PPE protects us from harm.

15. D — A paper dust mask
   Disposable masks should not be washed.

16. C — About 1 cm each time
   The raw edge is hidden.

17. B — Cotton
   Cotton is easy to handle.

18. C — 25 cm by 25 cm
   A small handkerchief is easy to make.

19. B — With the points held down
   This avoids injury.

20. A — Cut and pull it out
   Tacking is temporary.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: It prevents diseases, keeps food safe, prevents accidents and looks pleasant.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Never put needles in the mouth; keep them in a pin cushion; count them; carry scissors with points down (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Uneven stitches, pulling the thread too tight, using thread the same colour as the cloth, making a hard knot at the end (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mistake.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash with soap and water, rinse well and dry in the sun to help kill germs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Gloves protect hands from dirt and cuts; gumboots protect feet from mud; hat protects the head from the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each item with reason.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dust falls to the floor, so sweeping afterwards removes it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dust falls, 1 mark for sweeping removes.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keeping the home and its surroundings clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for keeping clean, 1 mark for the home.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hold layers of cloth together, mark a line, keep hems in place, help to sew straight (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each use.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sweeping, dusting, mopping and disposal of refuse (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each method.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: Compost organic waste; put other waste in a bin with a lid and take it to a collection point; reuse or recycle paper, plastic and glass; wrap broken glass.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pins can slip or prick, tacking holds cloth firmly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
